{{Top|leg}}
'''Stink''' was the foul-smelling secretion produced by dead [[slashrat]]s, warning other slashrats away. It was used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Anki Pace]]'s [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeological]] team to keep safe from slashrat attacks during their expedition to [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]]; they were the ones who dubbed it "stink".
